senses.gloss:
__1 Ā (एधते, एधाञ्चके, ऐधिष्ट, एधितुम्, एधित) 1 To grow, increase; विनापि संगमं स्त्रीणां कवीनां सुखमेधते [[Pt. 2. 164.]] 
__2 To prosper, become happy, live in comfort; द्वावेतौ सुखमेधेते [[Pt. 1. 318.]] 
__3 To grow strong, become [Page0500-2] great. 
__4 To extend. 
__5 To swell, rise. 
-Caus. To cause to grow or increase; to greet, celebrate, honour; नैदिधः स्वपराकम् [[Bk. 15. 19]]; (तां) आशीर्भिरेधयामासुः [[Ku. 6. 90.]] -Desid. एदिधिषते.
